description.zh: 简单柱轴具上部长叶、显著顶生孢子叶穗和分瓣基部。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Pleuromeia; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Pleuromeia 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Single dominant terminal cone and lobed foot differ from Chaloneria and the existing multi-stem horsetail patch.
distinctness.zh: 单一优势顶穗及分瓣根足区别于Chaloneria及现有多茎木贼丛。

modeling_brief.en: Use a stout tapered axis, separate crown blades and a readable cone silhouette; do not add tree branches.
